acceptedAnswer.text: Foundation repair coordination involves managing all aspects of a foundation repair project, from initial assessment and engineering to securing permits and overseeing construction. For Hometelligent Inc., this includes working with structural engineers to develop repair plans, obtaining necessary city or county permits in areas like Alameda and Berkeley, and scheduling the work with skilled crews. Effective coordination ensures that the project progresses smoothly, adheres to local building codes, and minimizes disruption to the homeowner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation repair coordination manages all project aspects, including assessment, engineering, permitting, and construction oversight, ensuring a smooth and compliant process.
